login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your phone number. We'll text you a code.
login.notRegistered: This number is not registered. Ask your office to add you.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

verify.title: Enter the code
verify.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}
verify.expired: Code expired. Request a new one.

selectCompany.title: Which company?
selectCompany.subtitle: Your number is linked to more than one company.

noCompany: Your account is not linked to an active company.
legal: By signing in you agree to share your location when you clock in and to receive text messages from your company.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.subtitle: Before you start, please review how PugBuild works with your data.

terms.title: Terms and privacy
terms.body: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

location.title: Location at clock-in
location.body: PugBuild records your GPS position only when you tap Start or Stop, and shares it with your employer to match the job site.

sms.title: Text messages
sms.body: I agree to receive operational text messages from PugBuild (sign-in codes, pay notices). Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.

welcome.decline: I don't agree, sign me out
